eventDetail.scope: BuildSEC'26 focuses on cybersecurity, privacy, and digital trust, bringing together researchers, industry professionals, and policymakers to address challenges in protecting people, systems, and data across increasingly connected digital environments. The conference covers a broad range of topics including critical infrastructure security, IoT and cloud security, cryptography and post-quantum security, secure software development, digital forensics, identity and access management, blockchain security, AI/ML security (including generative AI and LLMs), privacy-preserving technologies, hardware and firmware security, ransomware countermeasures, and policy/legal frameworks for cybersecurity. It emphasizes practical, real-world solutions alongside academic research to build a safer and more trusted digital future.
